blocks.intro: Your URS is the reference throughout (Annex 15, 3.2); every requirement keeps its ID.

items.q: Can the company that builds the system also qualify it?
items.a: Yes, under your control. Your quality unit approves every protocol before execution and every report after; we write and execute (Annex 15, 2.6).

items.q: Can we buy one stage only?
items.a: Yes. Each service has its own first step and its own documents.

items.q: Do you work on systems built by other suppliers?
items.a: Yes, for [makes and equipment types serviced]. We start with an assessment or condition survey, so the quote carries no hidden contingency.

items.q: How long from URS to water released?
items.a: For a packaged PW skid: [design to DQ, weeks] to DQ, [approved design to FAT, weeks] to FAT, [IQ/OQ on site, days] for IQ and OQ. Then PQ.

items.q: What does one traceability matrix look like?
items.a: URS-012, PW conductivity ≤ 1.3 µS/cm, becomes a divert clause, numbered sensor tees on weld maps, a FAT divert test flagged for OQ, and PQ data.
